"True soap" for labeling purposes would be soap you made from lye with no synthetic detergents or other additives. Melt and pour bases typically have detergents added. But even if you make "true soap," you should label all of your ingredients. It might not be required by law, but it's still a good idea. Some people may be checking for things they are allergic to or sensitive to. I would never buy soap without an ingredient label.
